instruction: Combine all .txt files from your vscode project into a single document "output.docx" on Desktop with LibreOffice Writer. Set line spacing to 1.5 and font size to 10.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.getWindowsWithTitle('output.docx'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires merging 5 txt files into a docx, setting line spacing to 1.5, and font size to 10. Evaluator checks line spacing and font size.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: All 3 requirements verified - content merging (via min_content_length), line spacing (1.5), and font size (10)
Correct logical implementation: Getter now checks ALL paragraphs (lines 36-43) and ALL runs (lines 45-53), not just the first one - this fixes the previous critical issue
Proper partial credit: Metric awards balanced scores (33.3%/33.3%/33.4%) for each requirement, allowing granular assessment
Practical state extraction: Postconfig saves file with Ctrl+S, getter successfully reads docx using python-docx library, all data extraction logic is sound
Minor weakness: Content verification uses min_content_length (100 chars) as a heuristic rather than verifying exact content from source .txt files, but this is a reasonable practical trade-off
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional enhancement: Could strengthen content verification by reading source .txt files from /home/user/Desktop/doc_proc/ and comparing total character count or checking for presence of specific snippets from each file, though current approach is acceptable
